decisions.same_model_and_effort_for_all_systems: Confirmed by the team on 2026-11-15 for a fair comparison.
decisions.limits: 8 first candidates, 6 lookups, and 2 submissions were set as defaults before any model run. They have not been tuned on any family. If they are tuned, use development families only.
decisions.retrieval: BM25. Hybrid retrieval with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 and with MedCPT did not beat BM25 at 5 or 10 candidates on development families.
decisions.instructions: Changed once on 2026-11-15 after the first development runs, the same wording for every system: judge the component's own claim, not its context. Checked on 32 ANB020-004 components and kept. Not tuned further.
decisions.not_found_rule: A system may answer not_found_in_supplied_sap after a documented search, and the record lists the searches.
decisions.spending_cap: Set with --max-usd when the API key arrives.
decisions.freeze: Run benchmark/freeze_config.py, commit the frozen file alone, and tag that commit. One person runs the held-out evaluation once.

note: Settings the team must review and freeze before the held-out evaluation. Copy to a dated file once frozen and pass that file to benchmark/evaluate.py --frozen-config. Record the git commit of the code at freeze time.

scoring.link_match: same SAP page and the cited passage window contains the reference anchor
scoring.equivalent_spans: unmatched links are adjudicated by a human before being counted as unsupported
